result.rationale: The diff shows validates_format_of with /[a-z...]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(/.*)?\Z/i (case-insensitive, port allowed) while before_validation only strips scheme and path, leaving case and port intact. record_for_host queries where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host), and URI#host is lowercase without port. So 'MySite.COM' or 'example.com:8080' passes validation and saves successfully but can never match, silently breaking embedding for that host. This is a real correctness defect introduced by the new model code in this diff.

judged_text: Validation accepts hosts the matcher can never resolve: the format regex permits uppercase and an optional :port while before_validation only strips scheme/path, but record_for_host matches lower(host) against URI#host, which is lowercase and port-less. An admin saves 'MySite.COM' or 'example.com:8080', gets a success response, and embedding from that host remains denied with no feedback that the entry is dead.
